title: Waterjet: add 2D WaterjetProfile operation with open leads, tabs as gaps, and inner-first order

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:max
labels.description: New algorithms, formats or open design (issue-worker-max)

body:
Add a dedicated `WaterjetProfile` 2D through-cut operation by extracting shared sheet-cutting helpers from `motion::plasma` and `motion::wire_edm`.

Depends on #1881 and #1882.

## Scope

- **Shared 2D sheet kernel (`crates/motion/src/`):**
  - Extract pure contour nesting (`nest.rs`), `Region::offset` kerf rings (`ring.rs`), `kerf_law` / `cover_law` (`laws.rs`), open-contour left/right offsets (`wire_edm/open.rs`), and flat tab splitting (`wire_edm/tabs.rs`) into shared helpers.
  - Reuse those helpers across `plasma`, `wire_edm`, and `waterjet` without duplicating geometry logic.
  - Add straight and arc lead-in/lead-out support on open chains created by tab gaps (`crates/motion/src/plasma/emit.rs` currently cuts open chains on centerline with no leads).
- **Waterjet profile generator (`crates/motion/src/waterjet/`):**
  - Cut inner holes before enclosing outer contours.
  - Offset geometry by half-kerf (outside, inside, or left/right open chains) with optional control compensation (`G41`/`G42`) when supported.
  - Cut flat tabs as uncut gaps (`count`, `width`, `at`) that turn closed loops into open chains with safe pierce leads outside the part edge.
  - Handle tight holes by shortening leads to clear opposite kerf or center-piercing when needed, without plasma THC assumptions.
  - Apply configurable arc linearization (`Move::chords(tol)`) when enabled.
- **App, commands, persistence, and UI (`crates/app`, `crates/ui`):**
  - Register `OpType::WaterjetProfile`, `Family::Waterjet`, and `Section::Waterjet` in `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`.
  - Add undoable commands, `.camproj` serialization DTO, UI ribbon mode/icon/page (kerf side, leads, tabs, pierce and abrasive dwell, cut-data selection, without plasma height/THC fields).

**Done means:** `WaterjetProfile` generates inner-first kerf-offset paths with leads on closed contours and tabbed open chains, round-trips in `.camproj` via undoable commands, shows in the UI on `Kind::Waterjet` machines, and matches golden CL output for a tabbed plate with holes.

Part of #1525
